abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Rainbow Float
abilities.text: If any basic Energy card attached to Flygon is the same type as any of your Pokémon, the Retreat Cost for those Pokémon is 0.

attacks.name: Sand Wall
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium card your opponent has in play. If you do, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Flygon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Power Swing
attacks.text: Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each Evolved Pokémon on your Bench.

text.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Energy Absorption
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to Mewtwo.

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard a {Psychic} Energy attached to Mewtwo and remove 6 damage counters from Mewtwo.

text.flavor: A Pokémon created by recombining MEW's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

text.name: Claydol

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Cosmic Power
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose up to 2 cards from your hand and put them on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you do, draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. This power can't be used if Claydol is affected by a Special Condition.

text.flavor: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

text.name: Azelf

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Time Walk
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Azelf from your hand onto your Bench, you may look at all of your face-down Prize cards. If you do, you may choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then, choose 1 card in your hand and put it as a Prize card face down.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Willpower," it sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

text.name: Palkia

attacks.name: Spacial Rend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If there is any Stadium card in play, discard it.

attacks.name: Transback
attacks.text: You may flip a coin. If heads, discard all Energy attached to Palkia and put the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your opponent's deck. Your opponent shuffles his or her deck afterward.

text.flavor: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Maternal Comfort
abilities.text: At any time between turns, remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Maternal Comfort Poké-Body between turns.

attacks.name: Ruthless Tail
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

text.name: Uxie

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Set Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Uxie from your hand onto your Bench, you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Restore
attacks.text: You may put Uxie and all cards attached to it on the bottom of your deck in any order.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Knowledge," it is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

text.name: Vibrava

attacks.name: Energy Typhoon
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of Energy cards in your opponent's discard pile. Then, put those Energy cards on top of your opponent's deck. Your opponent shuffles his or her deck afterward.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.

text.flavor: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

text.name: Unown G

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: GUARD
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Unown G is on your Bench, you may discard all cards attached to Unown G and attach Unown G to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. As long as Unown G is attached to a Pokémon, prevent all effects of attacks, excluding damage, done to that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: If Unown G has any damage counters on it, this attack's base damage is 10.

text.flavor: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whose language of UNOWN came first.

text.name: Baltoy

attacks.name: Psychic Balance
attacks.text: If you have less cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent. (If you have more or the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does nothing.)

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch Baltoy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

text.name: Nidoran ♀

attacks.name: Offer Help
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

text.name: Luxury Ball
effect: Search your deck for a Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X), show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If any Luxury Ball is in your discard pile, you can't play this card.

text.name: Poké Drawer +
effect: You may play 2 Poké Drawer + at the same time. If you play 1 Poké Drawer +, draw a card. If you play 2 Poké Drawer +, search your deck for up to 2 cards, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Bebe's Search
effect: Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Premier Ball
effect: Search your deck or your discard pile for a Pokémon LV.X, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you search your deck, shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Call Energy
effect: Call Energy provides {Colorless} Energy. Once during your turn, if the Pokémon Call Energy is attached to is your Active Pokémon, you may search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. If you do, shuffle your deck and your turn ends.

text.name: Rare Candy
effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.)

text.name: Upper Energy
effect: Upper Energy provides Colorless Energy. If you have more Prize cards left than your opponent and this card is attached to a Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X), Upper Energy provides Colorless Colorless Energy.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Wind Erosion
abilities.text: As long as Flygon is your Active Pokémon, discard the top card from your opponent's deck between turns.

attacks.name: Extreme Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon LV.X. This attack does 150 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.text: Put this card onto your Active Flygon. Flygon LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

text.name: Memory Berry
effect: Attach Memory Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.
The Pokémon this card is attached to can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon or its Stage 1 Evolution card. (You still have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.)

text.name: Trapinch

attacks.name: Inviting Trap
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

text.name: Night Maintenance
effect: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

text.name: Roseanne's Research
effect: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Basic Pokémon and basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Psybarrier
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Mewtwo by your opponent's Pokémon that isn't an Evolved Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giga Burn
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Mewtwo.

rules.text: Put this card onto your Active Mewtwo. Mewtwo LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Restructure
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, you switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Palkia is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Reflect
attacks.text: You may move all Energy cards attached to Palkia to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. (Ignore this effect if you don't have any Benched Pokémon.)

rules.text: Put this card onto your Active Palkia. Palkia LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous Level.
